heading: **2 December 2025**
body:
*Hia5 testing in SELEX buffers*

Concentration of original Hia5testlig ssDNA tube is about 7.5 ug/uL

Dilute this 1:200 ⇒ 1 uL oligo \+ 199 uL TE buffer (Hia5-d200)

PCR 1 → 25X

| Reagent | Volume (µL) |
| ----- | ----- |
| **Final diluted DNA** | **5** |
| **Phusion Master Mix** | **250** |
| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **25** |
| **NCAP\_R (10 uM)** | **25** |
| **Water** | **195**  |
| **Total** | **500** |

This uses \~7-8 ng of the ssDNA as template per reaction. 

| 98°C | 3 min |
| :---- | :---- |
| 98°C | 10 s |
| 55°C | 15 s       **8X\*** |
| 72°C | 30 s |
| 72°C | 40 min |
| 4°C | HOLD |

Quantify this product and then set up PCR2.

*Right sided SPRI size selection*

70 uL per sample \+ 52.5 uL beads ⇒ RT, 2 mins  
Magnetic separation ⇒ 5 mins  
Transfer supernatant and add 73.5 uL SPRI beads per sample ⇒ RT, 2 mins  
Magnetic separation ⇒ RT, 5 mins  
Wash twice with 85% ethanol  
Elute in 100 uL TE buffer

Run on Bioanalyzer.
